cohort: Women with singleton term breech or cephalic births planned for a home or birth center setting
finding: While planned out-of-hospital breech births were associated with higher rates of transfer of care and cesarean section, they led to high rates of vaginal birth and good maternal outcomes for both breech and cephalic presentations.
mod_finding: Out-of-hospital vaginal breech birth under specific protocol guidelines and with a skilled provider may be a reasonable choice for women wishing to avoid a cesarean section-especially when there is no option of a hospital breech birth.
birth_weight: Reported, but specific values not included in the abstract
